Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection, but not from a live run: current main advertises `FeatureCrabboxSync` for Daytona while metadata says `archive-sync`, and the delegated option gate rejects `--sync-only`/`--force-sync-large` without `FeatureArchiveSync`.

target.title: fix: declare archive-sync feature for daytona provider
target.body:
## Summary

- `internal/providers/daytona/provider.go`: declare `FeatureArchiveSync` instead of `FeatureCrabboxSync`. Daytona syncs by streaming a gzipped tar archive through the Daytona toolbox API (`internal/providers/daytona/upload.go`), and both `docs/providers/daytona.md` and `docs/providers/provider-metadata.json` (`sync: "archive-sync"`) already describe it that way — the spec was the odd one out, producing a self-contradictory generated matrix row (`archive-sync` sync column next to a `crabbox-sync` feature).
- User-visible fixes that fall out of the corrected feature:
  - `crabbox run --provider daytona --sync-only` and `--force-sync-large` now reach the backend, which already implements both (`backend_run.go` handles `SyncOnly` and passes `ForceSyncLarge` to the sync preflight); previously the delegated-run option gate (`internal/cli/run.go` → `RejectDelegatedSyncOptionsForSpec`) rejected them because the spec lacked `archive-sync`. `docs/providers/daytona.md` updated accordingly.
  - `crabbox doctor --provider daytona` no longer demands `rsync` (never used by this backend); `tar` is still required through the archive-sync path.
- `internal/providers/all/all_test.go`: the kind/feature contract reserved `archive-sync` for `delegated-run` providers. Daytona is an SSH-lease hybrid whose run and sync planes are delegated to provider APIs, so the contract now allows `archive-sync` on `ssh-lease` providers that also advertise `ssh`, and the `--sync-only`/`--force-sync-large`/`--checksum` gate conformance test now covers such hybrids instead of skipping them.
- `scripts/generate-provider-matrix.mjs`: `validate()` now cross-checks `provider-metadata.json`'s `sync` value against the compiled feature set in both directions, so this drift class fails `scripts/check-docs.sh` in the future. The check passes for all 71 providers after the daytona fix (daytona was the only mismatch fleet-wide).
- `docs/providers/README.md`: regenerated.

Part of the drift cleanup around https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/944.

## Notes

- **Design question for maintainers:** this loosens `TestProviderKindFeatureContracts` for SSH-lease hybrids. The alternative — keeping the strict contract and changing the metadata to `crabbox-sync` — would misdescribe the implementation (the backend never uses the Crabbox rsync-over-SSH plane) and would leave `--sync-only`/`--force-sync-large` rejected despite being implemented. Happy to rework if you prefer the strict contract with a different resolution.
- Recommendation scoring in `crabbox providers` shifts slightly for daytona (it no longer scores as "uses Crabbox sync and run" / "debug a synced checkout through SSH", and now scores on the archive-sync execution signals), which matches its actual data plane.
- `internal/cli/providers_builtin_test.go`'s daytona fixture updated to match the real spec.

## Verification

- `go build -trimpath -o bin/crabbox ./cmd/crabbox`
- `go test -race ./internal/providers/daytona/... ./internal/providers/all/... -count=1`
- `go test -race ./internal/cli/ -run 'Provider|Daytona|Matrix|Doctor' -count=1`
- `go vet ./internal/providers/... ./internal/cli/`
- `node scripts/generate-provider-matrix.mjs` (regenerates `docs/providers/README.md`; `--check` clean)
- `bash scripts/check-docs.sh` (command surface, provider matrix, links, docs-site build — all pass)
- Full `go test -race ./internal/cli/ -count=1` has one failure on this machine, `TestControllerTrackedChildDiesWithControllerProcess`, which also fails on an untouched `main` checkout here (pre-existing local environment flake, unrelated to this change).
